renderd.description: Global settings for the renderd daemon, including threading, timeouts, and Mapnik XML paths.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads to spawn for concurrent tile rendering.

tile_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait before aborting a tile render.

xml.description: List of paths to Mapnik XML configuration files for rendering.

items.description: Absolute path to a Mapnik XML stylesheet.

socket_name.description: Unix socket path for inter-process communication with mod_tile or other clients.

max_conn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the renderd socket.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting (set to `true` for detailed output).

maps.description: List of map layer configurations. Each entry defines a separate map (e.g., 'osm', 'cycle') with its own rendering parameters.

name.description: Unique name of the map layer; used as section header in the config.

xml.description: Path to the Mapnik XML stylesheet defining this map’s layers, styles, and data sources.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind this map’s HTTP tile server to.

port.description: TCP port to serve tiles for this map via HTTP (if enabled).

tile_dir.description: Directory where rendered tiles for this map are stored on disk (supports mod_tile caching).

mapnik_image_quality.description: Compression quality for formats that support it (e.g., JPEG: 0–100; PNG: 0–9 compression level).
